final_message:
DONE

I built two workbooks, but one requested criterion could not be done: metrics A1 and C1.

**Sample size.** 65 items are required. I used a 90% confidence level, a 10% tolerable error rate, and an assumed 50% expected error rate because no prior error rate was supplied. With the finite-population correction (1,516 rows), that gives 64.8, rounded up to 65. Without the correction it is 68. A minimum "no errors expected" check gives 22; I did not adopt it. The workings are in the "Sample Size Calculation" tab.

**Sample.** I selected exactly 65 rows. Every selected row meets at least one criterion, and every criterion is met except A1/C1. All 4 Divisions, all 13 sub-Divisions and all 17 KRIs are covered. The selected rows include the 13 largest movements: ten changes of 44x or more, plus the three largest cases where Q2 was zero and Q3 was not.

**Unresolved points**
- **A1 and C1:** the Population has no metric codes, only KRI names. I did not guess a mapping, so no row is claimed for this criterion. Once management supplies the code-to-KRI mapping, add the matching rows.
- **Proxy entities:** the named entities don't exist in the data, so I used the closest match and flagged each one in the "Selection Notes" tab.

| Requested entity or business | Used in the data |
|---|---|
| CB Cash Italy | Corporate Bank, Italy |
| IB Debt Markets Luxembourg | Luxembourg Markets-Trading and Syndicated Lending |
| CB Trade Finance Brazil | Corporate Bank, Marine Finance, Brazil |
| Trade Finance business | Marine Finance |
| PB EMEA UAE | Retail Bank, EMEA, UAE |

- **Column positions:** the supplied file has Q3 in column G and Q2 in column H, and nothing in I to K. I kept columns A–H unchanged, put the absolute variance in I, the QoQ variance % in J and the sample flag in K. So the quarters sit in G and H, not H and I.
- **Variance:** (Q3 − Q2) / |Q2|. Where Q2 is zero and Q3 is not (83 rows), the percentage is undefined; it shows "n/a (Q2=0)" and counts as over 20%.
- **Source version:** I treated "Population v2.xlsx" as the operative file, since no registry or operations records were supplied.

The "Selection Notes" tab also lists data-quality points to follow up, such as a truncated Spain entity name and repeated entity/KRI combinations.

I used xlsxwriter so the formulas carry stored values and show in any viewer. Sampled rows are highlighted.

Files are in outputs/:
- Sample.xlsx
- Population - variance analysis and sample selection.xlsx

The first holds the 65 selected rows, the sample size workings and the selection notes. The second holds the full 1,516-row Population with columns J and K plus the same two other tabs.
